R1.description: A timed exercise shows a Clock card above its Time card, reading 0:00, the target line and Start; a weight-and-reps or reps-only exercise shows none and looks as before, and a logged timed set's correction sheet shows no clock

R2.description: Start makes the card count up in m:ss from a stored start moment, with the target line in view and Stop in Start's place; on reaching the target the time turns accent, the card gets an accent edge, and a check mark and words say so while it keeps counting; the readout never shows a negative time

R3.description: Stop writes the elapsed whole seconds into the entry, still editable before Log set; the card keeps the time with Stopped at and offers Start again, and the Time card says it was filled in; once a set has saved the clock is back at 0:00 with Start offered and the Time card keeps its value, and a failed save changes nothing; a stop under one second leaves the entry as it was and goes back to before Start; stopping never logs a set

R4.description: The running clock survives a rotation, a trip to the Board, switching exercise, process death, and Leave it running followed by Resume, because it is derived from the start moment; Log set is disabled while it runs

R5.description: Start ends a running rest and cancels its alert, Stop never starts a rest, and the next rest starts after Log set as today

R6.description: Typing or stepping a time by hand works as before; nothing is stored in Room, the backup or the CSV; the clock is readable by a screen reader and fits at font scale 2.0
